secrets.name: LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. API key for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. OpenAI, OpenRouter). Powers natural-language query parsing and source extraction; without it a local keyword parser and rule-based extraction are used.

secrets.name: LLM_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1
